sections: HCM-2.4 — convert the remaining shipped artifact families

repo_truth: At clean synchronized baseline commit 2b7ab4e14467800e5f0ecaa19561a1dd5d84ee48, Stage A's causal-cascade amendment is landed and reviewed CLEAN. The frozen HCM-2.4 planning subject contains four Markdown files only. It inventories exactly six shipped first-party kinds plus HCM-2.3 registry-brief preservation; classifies canonical YAML, derived Markdown, and non-HCM outputs; splits exact version publication, CRITICAL shipped-root adoption, Environment Context, Work Specification, Decision Record, Risk Record, HIGH aggregate flow deletion, and Phase 2 closeout; records HIGH/CRITICAL/UNKNOWN GitNexus results; and prohibits implementation and all declared non-goals.
allowed_scope: Replay the four-entry subject manifest and aggregate fingerprint before reviewing.
Review completeness and correctness of the six-family inventory and pre-Phase-3 output classifications.
Review that each targeted family has exactly one editable canonical YAML truth and every retained Markdown surface is renderer-only with zero authority influence.
Review preservation of Charter, Project Context, the exact three-instance shipped-root profile, and HCM-2.3 registry-brief authority.
Review exact bridge/helper deletion triggers, source-compatible treatment of exported fixed-layout shells, packet decomposition, dependency order, selectors, and atomicity claims.
Review GitNexus blast-radius recording and whether HIGH, CRITICAL, incomplete, and UNKNOWN results produce proportionate packet isolation and stop behavior.
Review proof-wall and Phase 2 exit mapping, causal-cascade review budget, explicit non-goals, authority stops, and implementation-entry acceptance criteria.
Apply the integrated-outcome P1/P2/P3/P4 rubric and return all complete-subject discovery findings in one consolidated response.
non_goals: No implementation edits, test edits, definition publication, schema changes, template changes, staging, commits, pushes, handoffs, ledger writes, or delegation.

No HCM-3.x Context Resolution, capitalized Projection, generic custom Projection, SDK, transport, remote schema, generated command, dynamic path, migration, dual-read, dependency, Cargo, unsafe-policy, package-boundary, or public API work.
No open-ended adversarial discovery beyond whether this frozen plan can meet the selected HCM-2.4 and Phase 2 exit outcomes.
No demand for speculative hardening as P1/P2 without a demonstrated selected-outcome failure.
tasks: Verify exact subject identity and planning-only scope.
Read the four subject files plus only the cited authority needed to test a claimed obligation.
Identify contradictions, missing family/selector/proof/authority decisions, infeasible packet boundaries, or non-goal leaks that would prevent implementation from satisfying HCM-2.4.
Consolidate every demonstrated P1/P2 with stable IDs, exact evidence, supported or repository-reachable failure state, and bounded remediation.
List P3/P4 separately with canonical-inventory disposition; return CLEAN only if no P1/P2 exists.
stop_conditions: Return blocked if the subject fingerprint cannot be replayed or cited authority is unavailable.
Return any demonstrated P1/P2 to the parent without editing; do not widen implementation scope or risk ceiling.
Do not delegate, implement, create another dispatch, write a handoff, or modify the ledger.
